# THREAD

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Jiacheng-Lou/THREAD/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jiacheng-Lou/THREAD/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![pkgdown](https://github.com/Jiacheng-Lou/THREAD/actions/workflows/pkgdown.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jiacheng-Lou/THREAD/actions/workflows/pkgdown.yaml)

**THREAD** (*Trait Heterogeneity Regression through Expression
Annotation and Dirichlet processes*) integrates LD-corrected gene-level
GWAS responses with gene-by-cellular-label expression profiles. Its
heteroscedastic Bayesian nonparametric model infers latent gene modules
and module-specific cellular coefficients.

Analyses can begin with raw GWAS and single-cell data or with prepared
SNP-to-gene mappings, gene-level responses, or model inputs.

## Main capabilities

- Preprocess GWAS summaries and aggregate single-cell expression into a
  gene-by-cellular-label matrix.
- Map SNPs to genes and construct LD-corrected gene-level responses with
  heteroscedastic uncertainty.
- Infer latent gene modules and module-specific cellular coefficients
  with a Dirichlet process mixture.
- Assess module-cellular-label associations using frequentist and
  Bayesian criteria.
- Produce downstream gene and cellular-label prioritization scores.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub and load the package:

``` r

remotes::install_github("Jiacheng-Lou/THREAD", build_vignettes = TRUE)
library(THREAD)
```

## Quick start

The installed example data demonstrate the interface only; they do not
support biological conclusions. This example prepares model input from
an expression matrix and a gene-level response:

``` r

library(THREAD)

example_dir <- system.file(
  "extdata", "example", package = "THREAD", mustWork = TRUE
)
example_X <- readRDS(file.path(example_dir, "example_x.rds"))
example_response <- readRDS(file.path(example_dir, "example_response.rds"))

thread_data <- prepare_input(
  X = example_X,
  response = example_response,
  K_init = 3L,
  min_genes = 10L,
  seed = 2028L,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

See [Getting
Started](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/articles/get-started.html)
for fitting, partitioning, association inference, and scores.

## Documentation

- [THREAD website](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/)
- [Getting Started with
  THREAD](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/articles/get-started.html)
- [Computing the LD-Corrected Gene-Level
  Response](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/articles/compute-gene-response.html)
- [THREAD Input Formats and Workflow Entry
  Points](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/articles/input-formats-and-entry-points.html)
- [Function
  reference](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/index.html)

Full genome-wide LD reference data are not bundled with THREAD.
Workflows that compute gene-level responses require a compatible
external LD reference; see the response and input-format articles for
details.

## Citation

To obtain the current package citation, run:

``` r

citation("THREAD")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cell_type_score()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/cell_type_score.md)
  : Integrated cell-subtype importance score (PLACEHOLDER)
- [`combine_response_by_chr()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/combine_response_by_chr.md)
  : Combine chromosome-level response files
- [`compute_response()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/compute_response.md)
  : Compute LD-based heteroscedastic gene-level THREAD response
- [`gene_score()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/gene_score.md)
  : Score and rank genes within each module
- [`get_partition()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/get_partition.md)
  : Point estimate of the gene partition from a fitted THREAD model
- [`init_clusters()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/init_clusters.md)
  : Generate initial gene-cluster labels
- [`match_snps_to_genes()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/match_snps_to_genes.md)
  : Match GWAS SNPs to gene windows
- [`prepare_input()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/prepare_input.md)
  : Prepare THREAD model input
- [`preprocess_gwas()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/preprocess_gwas.md)
  : Quality-control and harmonise GWAS summary statistics
- [`preprocess_scrna()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/preprocess_scrna.md)
  : Preprocess single-cell expression into a THREAD expression matrix
- [`read_gene2vec()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/read_gene2vec.md)
  : Read a gene2vec embedding file
- [`read_gene_annotation()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/read_gene_annotation.md)
  : Read a gene annotation table
- [`recommend_priors()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/recommend_priors.md)
  : Recommend empirical-Bayes prior hyperparameters
- [`run_thread()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/run_thread.md)
  : Fit the THREAD model by MCMC
- [`standardize_gene_annotation_for_matching()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/standardize_gene_annotation_for_matching.md)
  : Standardize a gene annotation table for SNP-to-gene matching
- [`standardize_gwas_for_matching()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/standardize_gwas_for_matching.md)
  : Standardize GWAS summary statistics for SNP-to-gene matching
- [`test_significance()`](https://jiacheng-lou.github.io/THREAD/reference/test_significance.md)
  : Dual-significance testing of module / cell-subtype associations
